title: The Test and Find Model
summary: We introduce the Test and Find (TF) problem, where a decision maker (DM) faces the following situation: $k$ identical objects are randomly allocated to $n$ distinct boxes (sites) according to some distribution $π$, with no more than one object to a box. The DM tests all of the boxes. However, the tests are imperfect: they can give false positive or false negative results. DM has $m$ tags, $1\leq m\leq n$, and, after testing all boxes, she can place a tag on any box that she thinks has a hidden object. She is rewarded $c_i$ for a correct guess and penalized $d_i$ for a wrong guess in box $i$.…
